title: Causal graph: Checkout failures
description: Hypotheses and the outcomes of causal assertions, linked by cause role, with evidence counts.

legend.label: root cause
legend.description: A solid line from a hypothesis to an outcome: the hypothesis is its root cause.

legend.label: trigger
legend.description: A solid line from a hypothesis to an outcome: the hypothesis is its trigger.

legend.label: contributing factor
legend.description: A dashed line from a hypothesis to an outcome: the hypothesis is its contributing factor.

legend.label: enabling condition
legend.description: A dotted line from a hypothesis to an outcome: the hypothesis is its enabling condition.
